verdict.rationale: Stripe documents both API onboarding for a custom UI and an embeddable Account onboarding component that keeps sellers inside your app. It also documents identity verification for connected accounts and management of external (payout) accounts, and community reports describe the older OAuth account-connection flow as simple. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of Stripe-hosted onboarding pages, terms-of-service acceptance via the API, business (KYB) versus individual (KYC) verification detail, and bank-account linking as an onboarding step rather than payout management.
